```{r}
#| label: set-theme
#| include: false

set_theme(theme_bw())
```

During the first period of mass migration to the US between 1850-1960, immigrants diversified an ethnically homogenous white population before eventually being assimilated into a white mainstream. This was mostly keenly experienced in the period between 1880 and 1930 when immigration to the US shifted to Southern and Eastern European groups. The quota acts in the 1920s helped to largely reduce immigration and likely contributed to assimilation of these groups due to generational aging. 

Another factor in the assimilation process were the so-called "triple melting pots" driven by intermarriage. Intermarriage across ethnic groups, but within large religious groups (specifically, Catholics, Protestants, and Jews) helped to reduce ethnically based boundaries, but strengthened religious boundaries.

In this simulation, we will stylistically recreate this process by simulating the US population from 1870-1960, while allowing for multiple immigration streams.

Ideally, we might like to have detailed immigration streams that capture specific ethnic/national groups, but for this article, we will use fairly large immigrant streams that capture important groupings. We will use the following immigration streams:

- NW European: Including English, Scottish, Scandanavian, Dutch, and German immigrants. This was a more common immigrant flow in the early 19th century but receded in importance by the late 19th century.
- Irish: The only specific ethnic group used here. Irish immigrants dominated immigration flows in the mid-19th century but that flow had declined by the late 19th century relative to the Southern and Eastern European migrants.
- Southern European: Most commonly Italian immigrants.
- Eastern European: A mix of Slavic and non-Slavic groups, as well as many Jews.

```{r}
usa_historical_migration |>

  ggplot(aes(x = time_start + 0.5, y = rate, fill = stream))+
```

Lets do a real simple test first.

```{r}
#| label: create-template-pop
#| message: true

# Use Taiwan
mortality_taiwan <- get_mortality_hmd("TWN", 1980, shape = "5x1", open_age = 85)
fertility_taiwan <- get_fertility_hfd("TWN", 1976)

set.seed(42)
model_template <- hammel_model() |>
  set_fertility(fertility_taiwan) |>
  set_mortality(mortality_taiwan) |>
  set_union_formation("on_demand") |>
  set_population(
    generate_uniform_population(
      20000,
      end_time = 1780
    )
  )

pop_template <- run_simulation(model_template, 100, 42)
summary(pop_template)
```

```{r}

# we can't use canned HFD values because we need something
# that matches Haines 15-49 five year age groups
read_usa_hfd <- function(item) {
  HMDHFDplus::readHFDweb(
    CNTRY = "USA",
    item = item,
    username = Sys.getenv("HFD_USERNAME"),
    password = Sys.getenv("HFD_PASSWORD"),
    fixup = FALSE
  )
}

births <- read_usa_hfd("birthsRR") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(year = Year, age = Age, births = Total) |>
  mutate(age = as.numeric(str_remove(age, "\\+|\\-")))
exposure <- read_usa_hfd("exposRR") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(year = Year, age = Age, exposure = Exposure)

fertility <- full_join(births, exposure)

fertility_rates <- fertility |>
  filter(year <= 1960, !is.na(age) & age >= 15 & age < 50) |>
  mutate(
    time_start = year,
    time_end = time_start + 1,
    age_start = 5 * floor(age / 5),
    age_end = age_start + 5
  ) |>
  group_by(time_start, time_end, age_start, age_end) |>
  summarize(rate = sum(births) / sum(exposure), .groups = "drop")

fertility_rates |>
  calculate_tfr()

# stratify, allowing for slightly higher black fetility rates throughout
birthplaces <- pop_usa1880$groups$birthplace$categories
fertility_1933_1960 <- fertility_rates |>
  stratify_rates(
    by = list(
      race = c(White = 1, Black = 1.10, Other = 1),
      birthplace = stats::setNames(rep(1, length(birthplaces)), birthplaces)
    )
  )

fertility_1933_1960 |> calculate_tfr()

# use Haines 1989

haines_asfr <- tribble(
  ~race,   ~native,   ~time_start, ~time_end, ~age_start, ~age_end, ~rate,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      15,         20,       0.04867,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      20,         25,       0.16196,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      25,         30,       0.18367,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      30,         35,       0.14471,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      35,         40,       0.10149,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      40,         45,       0.02409,
  "White", "native",  1900,        1910,      45,         50,       0.00383,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      15,         20,       0.05856,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      20,         25,       0.18794,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      25,         30,       0.22502,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      30,         35,       0.20548,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      35,         40,       0.16368,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      40,         45,       0.05500,
  "White", "foreign", 1900,        1910,      45,         50,       0.00802,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      15,         20,       0.09994,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      20,         25,       0.25308,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      25,         30,       0.19358,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      30,         35,       0.15269,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      35,         40,       0.18413,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      40,         45,       0.06766,
  "Black", "native",  1900,        1910,      45,         50,       0.01837,
)

# expand to all immigrant streams. Assume Other racial group look likes 
# white case
foreign_birthplaces <- setdiff(
  pop_usa1880$groups$birthplace$categories,
  "native"
)

fertility_1900_1910 <- haines_asfr |>
  bind_rows(
    haines_asfr |>
      filter(race == "White") |>
      mutate(race = "Other"),
    haines_asfr |>
      filter(race == "Black", native == "native") |>
      mutate(native = "foreign")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    birthplace = lapply(native, function(nativity) {
      if (nativity == "native") "native" else foreign_birthplaces
    })
  ) |>
  unnest_longer(birthplace) |>
  select(race, birthplace, time_start, time_end, age_start, age_end, rate) |>
  arrange(race, birthplace, time_start, age_start)

# linear interpolation between those points
keys <- c("race", "birthplace", "age_start", "age_end")

start_rates <- fertility_1900_1910 |>
  select(dplyr::all_of(keys), rate_1910 = rate)

end_rates <- fertility_1933_1960 |>
  filter(time_start == 1933) |>
  select(all_of(keys), rate_1933 = rate)

fertility_1910_1933 <- start_rates |>
  inner_join(
    end_rates,
    by = keys,
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    unmatched = "error"
  ) |>
  cross_join(tibble(time_start = 1910:1932)) |>
  mutate(
    time_end = time_start + 1,
    rate = rate_1910 +
      (time_start - 1910) / (1933 - 1910) * (rate_1933 - rate_1910)
  ) |>
  select(-rate_1910, -rate_1933)

fertility_1900_1960 <- bind_rows(
  fertility_1900_1910,
  fertility_1910_1933,
  fertility_1933_1960
)

# for 1880 to 1900 use the 4.24 to 3.56 TFR change from 1880 to 1900
# from Haines and Hecker (2002) for white population to benchmark the change
fertility_1880_1900 <- fertility_1900_1910 |>
  select(-time_start, -time_end) |>
  cross_join(tibble::tibble(time_start = 1880:1899)) |>
  mutate(
    time_end = time_start + 1,
    rate = rate * (1 + (4.24 / 3.56 - 1) * (1900 - time_start) / 20)
  )

fertility_1880_1960 <- bind_rows(
  fertility_1880_1900,
  fertility_1900_1910,
  fertility_1910_1933,
  fertility_1933_1960
)
```

```{r}

mortality_hmd <- get_mortality_hmd("USA", 1933:1960, shape = "5x1", open_age = 80)


mortality_haines <- read_csv(
  here::here("data-raw", "haines_life_tables_1880_1900.csv")
)

mortality_1875_1905 <- mortality_haines |>
  filter(method == "us_brass", population == "total") |>
  # need to collapse 1-5 group
  mutate(
    age_start = if_else(age_start >= 1 & age_start < 5, 1, age_start),
    age_end = if_else(age_end >= 2 & age_end < 5, 5, age_end),
    time_start = year - 5,
    time_end = year + 5,
  ) |>
  # pool to get rate
  group_by(time_start, time_end, sex, age_start, age_end) |>
  summarize(rate = sum(dx) / sum(nLx), .groups = "drop")

# Carry the last Haines rates to the 1905 boundary, then interpolate to 1933.
mortality_keys <- c("sex", "age_start", "age_end")

mortality_1905_1933 <- mortality_1875_1905 |>
  filter(time_end == 1905) |>
  select(all_of(mortality_keys), rate_1905 = rate) |>
  inner_join(
    mortality_hmd |>
      filter(time_start == 1933) |>
      select(all_of(mortality_keys), rate_1933 = rate),
    by = mortality_keys,
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    unmatched = "error"
  ) |>
  cross_join(tibble(time_start = 1905:1932)) |>
  mutate(
    time_end = time_start + 1,
    rate = rate_1905 +
      (time_start - 1905) / (1933 - 1905) * (rate_1933 - rate_1905)
  ) |>
  select(-rate_1905, -rate_1933)

mortality_1875_1960 <- bind_rows(
  mortality_1875_1905,
  mortality_1905_1933,
  mortality_hmd
)

mortality_1875_1960 |>
  calculate_life_expectancy() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = (time_start + time_end) /2, y = ex, color = sex))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()


# lets get black/white mortality ratios for 1900 from Haines
mortality_race_ratios <- mortality_haines |>
  filter(
    method == "preston_haines_west",
    year == 1900,
    population %in% c("black", "white")
  ) |>
  mutate(age_start = if_else(age_start >= 1 & age_start < 5, 1, age_start)) |>
  group_by(sex, age_start, population) |>
  summarize(rate = sum(dx) / sum(nLx), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = population, values_from = rate) |>
  mutate(log_ratio = log(black / white))

# build a custom weight functions to use these ratios
race_log_ratios <- stats::xtabs(
  log_ratio ~ age_start + sex,
  data = mortality_race_ratios
)

mortality_weights <- weight_model(
  fun = function(members, bin) {
    race_log_ratio <- race_log_ratios[
      as.character(bin$age_start), members$sex
    ]

    (members$race == "Black") * race_log_ratio +
      log(1.05) * (members$birthplace %in% foreign_birthplaces)
  }
)
```




```{r}

generation_assign <- function(members) {
  ifelse(members$age < 18, "1.5", "1")
}

stream_irish <- immigration_stream(
  usa_historical_migration |> filter(stream == "irish") |> select(-stream),
  template = pop_template,
  assignment = list(
    generation = migrant_assignment("custom", fun = generation_assign),
    race = migrant_assignment("fixed", fixed_value = "White")
  )
)

stream_nw_europe <- immigration_stream(
  usa_historical_migration |> filter(stream == "nw_europe") |> select(-stream),
  template = pop_template,
  assignment = list(
    generation = migrant_assignment("custom", fun = generation_assign),
    race = migrant_assignment("fixed", fixed_value = "White")
  )
)

stream_south_europe <- immigration_stream(
  usa_historical_migration |> filter(stream == "south_europe") |> select(-stream),
  template = pop_template,
  assignment = list(
    generation = migrant_assignment("custom", fun = generation_assign),
    race = migrant_assignment("fixed", fixed_value = "White")
  )
)

stream_east_europe <- immigration_stream(
  usa_historical_migration |> filter(stream == "east_europe") |> select(-stream),
  template = pop_template,
  assignment = list(
    generation = migrant_assignment("custom", fun = generation_assign),
    race = migrant_assignment("fixed", fixed_value = "White")
  )
)

stream_other <- immigration_stream(
  usa_historical_migration |> filter(stream == "other") |> select(-stream),
  template = pop_template,
  assignment = list(
    generation = migrant_assignment("custom", fun = generation_assign),
    race = migrant_assignment("fixed", fixed_value = "Other")
  )
)
```




```{r}

model <- hammel_model() |>
  set_fertility(fertility_1880_1960) |>
  set_mortality(mortality_1875_1960, weights = mortality_weights) |>
  set_union_formation(
    "on_demand",
    matching = age_gap_matching_model(
      3, 5,
      group_exogamy = list(
        race = c("White:Black" = -7, "White:Other" = -4, "Black:Other" = -7)
      ),
      # the full endogamy for full ancestry individuals adds these together
      # start by assuming equal endogamy across groups
      # TODO: get reasonable estimates based on prior work
      ancestry_endogamy = list(
        birthplace = c(
          native = 1,
          irish = 1,
          nw_europe = 1,
          south_europe = 1,
          east_europe = 1,
          other = 1
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  set_immigration(
    irish = stream_irish,
    nw_europe = stream_nw_europe,
    east_europe = stream_east_europe,
    south_europe = stream_south_europe,
    other = stream_other,
    birthplace_ancestry = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_population(pop_usa1880)

pop_end <- run_simulation(model, 79.5, 42, union_weight_sample = 0.3)
summary(pop_end)
```

```{r}

diversity <- pop_end$ancestry$birthplace |>
  select(-unknown) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -person_id) |>
  mutate(diversity = value^2, entropy = value * log(1/ value, 6)) |>
  group_by(person_id) |>
  summarize(
    diversity = 1 - sum(diversity),
    entropy = sum(entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(pop_end$persons |> select(person_id, birth_time, race)) |>
  select(person_id, race, birth_time, diversity, entropy)

# diversity |>
#   filter(birth_time >= 1880) |>

#   geom_boxplot() +
#   #geom_jitter(alpha = 0.02)+
#   facet_wrap(~race)

diversity |>
  filter(birth_time >= 1800) |>
  mutate(year = floor(birth_time)) |>
  group_by(year, race) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(entropy), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean, color = race))+
  geom_line()+
  labs(y = "mean entropy")
```

```{r}
choice_sets <- extract_choice_sets(pop_end, 10000, 50)

choice_sets <- choice_sets |>
  mutate(,
    age_diff = birth_time_w - birth_time_h,
    d_native = abs(birthplace_native_h - birthplace_native_w),
    d_irish = abs(birthplace_irish_w - birthplace_irish_h),
    d_nw_europe = abs(birthplace_nw_europe_h - birthplace_nw_europe_w),
    d_east_europe = abs(birthplace_east_europe_h - birthplace_east_europe_w),
    d_south_europe = abs(birthplace_south_europe_h - birthplace_south_europe_w),
    d_other = abs(birthplace_other_h - birthplace_other_w),
    race_bw = (race_w == "Black" & race_h == "White") | (race_w == "White" & race_h == "Black"),
    race_bo = (race_w == "Black" & race_h == "Other") | (race_w == "Other" & race_h == "Black"),
    race_wo = (race_w == "Other" & race_h == "White") | (race_w == "White" & race_h == "Other")
  )

model <- clogit(chosen ~ age_diff + I(age_diff^2) +
  d_native + d_irish + d_nw_europe + d_east_europe + d_south_europe + d_other +
  race_bw + race_bo + race_wo +
  offset(log_weight) + strata(choice_id), 
  data = choice_sets)
summary(model)
modelsummary::modelsummary(model)
```
